authorization.method: AuthorizedCode header verification on main public-facing website
authorization.statement: Owner has placed the required AuthorizedCode header on the main public-facing website, granting full-scope vulnerability assessment permission on the company and its assets.

constraints: No destructive testing (no DDoS, malware, phishing, credential stuffing, brute force, MFA bypass, lateral movement)
No testing of out-of-scope third-party assets
No leaking of sensitive data discovered during the engagement
Minimum proof only; stop at verification
